title: Palestinian girl dies of wounds sustained by Israeli gunfire in southern Gaza
location: al-Mawasi, Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip
summary_or_snippet: WAFA reported that a six-year-old girl died Tuesday morning from wounds sustained in an earlier shooting in al-Mawasi, Khan Younis. The report does not specify when the shooting occurred.

title: Israeli forces set fire to displacement camp in Gaza City, displacing over 800 Palestinians
location: Shuja’iyya junction, east of Gaza City
summary_or_snippet: WAFA reported that a displacement-camp fire near the Shuja’iyya junction in eastern Gaza City, described as occurring the previous night, displaced more than 800 Palestinians and affected more than 200 families.

title: Two killed in Israeli occupation strike on Deir al-Balah
summary_or_snippet: WAFA reported that two Palestinians were killed and another was wounded in a drone strike on Deir al-Balah.
